inventedEvidence.evidence: 'Since you have already checked the water supply and cleaned the condenser' - the customer only said 'I can try the condenser' and never reported cleaning it

rationale: The assistant consistently told the customer to unplug before any work and eventually landed on the right direction (failed heater element or thermal cut-out needing a continuity test, then an engineer when she had no meter). However it treated a water-cooled Indesit washer-dryer as a condenser tumble dryer, sending her hunting for a non-existent lint filter 'at the bottom of the door opening', a pull-out condenser behind a front flap, and 'two metal strips' moisture sensors, and showed a condenser-dryer card. It parroted 'XWDE 96 SOMETHING' literally and never asked her to read the full model from the door label, and it stated she had 'cleaned the condenser' when she had not. The final escalation is correct but the route there wasted her effort on irrelevant checks.
